card.name: Words leading into symptom or effect clauses
card.fires_on: Linking words such as after, by, each, and take, or the middle of words like discontinuation and hypothalamic-pituitary. It fires in medical text just before a symptom, cause, or time-course statement.

modes.label: Cause or timing links
modes.description: Small words like after, by, each, take that introduce what follows from a cause or when an effect appears.
modes.example: The most common signs and symptoms observed are those caused<< by>> electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: Partway through words such as discontinuation, dilated, or pituitary.
modes.example: Symptoms associated with<< discontin>>uation of Citalopram Oral Solution

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that state a result or effect, such as 直接影响 and 决定了, though the output is mixed.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to say what causes a symptom or how long an effect takes.
